passages.title: My Dog Max
passages.text:
I have a dog. His name is Max. Max is two years old. He is brown and white. He has long ears and a short tail.

Max likes to play in the park. He runs fast and catches balls. Every morning, I give him bread and meat. He drinks a lot of water. In the afternoon, we play together in the garden. He is very happy.

At night, Max sleeps next to my bed. He is my best friend. I love Max very much.

questions.q: What colour is Max?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “He is brown and white.”，选 B，你真细心！

questions.q: Where does Max sleep at night?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “Max sleeps next to my bed.”，选 C，答得真棒！

questions.q: What does Max eat every morning?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “I give him bread and meat.”，选 B，找得又快又准！

questions.q: What is this passage about?
questions.explanation: 全文讲的是小作者和他的狗 Max，选 A，你读懂了全文！

questions.q: In “He runs fast and catches balls”, the word “catches” means ___.
questions.explanation: catches 是“接住”的意思，Max 跑得快，能接住球，选 C，真厉害！

passages.title: A Rainy Day
passages.text:
It is Saturday. The sky is grey. It starts to rain. Tom cannot play football outside.

Tom puts on his blue raincoat and red boots. He goes out with his little sister. Their dog Sam jumps with them. They jump in the water and laugh.

Then Mum calls them home. She makes hot soup and bread for lunch. “Rainy days are fun!” says Tom. After lunch, Tom reads a book with his sister. The rain stops in the evening.

questions.q: What day is it in the story?
questions.explanation: 第一句就说 “It is Saturday.”，选 C，观察力真强！

questions.q: What colour are Tom's boots?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “his blue raincoat and red boots”，靴子是红色的，选 A，真棒！

questions.q: What does Mum make for lunch?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “She makes hot soup and bread for lunch.”，选 D，答对啦！

questions.q: What is this story about?
options: Tom has fun on a rainy day
questions.explanation: Tom 在下雨天也玩得很开心，选 C，你抓住了故事的中心！

questions.q: In “The sky is grey”, the word “grey” means ___.
questions.explanation: 下雨天的天空是灰色的、阴阴的，选 A，猜得真准！

passages.title: Lily's School Day
passages.text:
Lily is eight years old. She goes to Sunny School. Her school starts at nine o'clock.

In the morning, Lily has English and maths. Her English teacher is Miss White. She is kind and funny. Lily likes her very much.

At twelve, Lily eats lunch with her friends in the school hall. After lunch, they play games in the playground. Lily's favourite lesson is art, because she likes drawing pictures. At four o'clock, she goes home by bus.

questions.q: How old is Lily?
questions.explanation: 第一句说 “Lily is eight years old.”，选 C，真棒！

questions.q: Who is Miss White?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “Her English teacher is Miss White.”，选 B，找得又快又准！

questions.q: What is Lily's favourite lesson?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “Lily's favourite lesson is art”，选 D，你读得真仔细！

questions.q: What is this passage about?
questions.explanation: 全文介绍了 Lily 一天在学校的生活，选 A，主旨把握得很好！

questions.q: In “She is kind and funny”, the word “kind” means ___.
questions.explanation: kind 是“和蔼的、友善的”，选 B，你已经会根据上下文猜词义了！

passages.title: Ben's Football Game
passages.text:
Ben's class has a football game today. The game is against Class Two. Ben plays very well.

In the first half, Class Two gets one goal. Ben is sad but he does not stop. He runs and runs.

In the second half, Ben kicks the ball hard. Goal! Then he kicks again. Goal! Ben's class wins two to one. All the children are happy. They sing and dance after the game. Ben is the hero of the day.

questions.q: Which class does Ben's class play against?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “The game is against Class Two.”，选 B，答得漂亮！

questions.q: Who gets the first goal?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “In the first half, Class Two gets one goal.”，选 C，你真细心！

questions.q: What is the score at the end?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “Ben's class wins two to one.”，选 D，找得真准！

questions.q: What is the story about?
questions.explanation: 故事讲 Ben 的班级逆转赢得了比赛，选 B，你读懂了全文！

questions.q: In “Ben's class wins two to one”, the word “wins” means ___.
questions.explanation: wins 是“赢”的意思，得分最高就是赢，选 C，真聪明！

passages.title: Grandma's Garden
passages.text:
Grandma has a small garden behind her house. There are red flowers and green trees in it. Two birds sing in the trees every morning.

On Sundays, I help Grandma in the garden. I give water to the flowers. Grandma plants carrots and potatoes. She tells me stories about her old cat.

In autumn, we pick big apples from the tree. Grandma makes apple cakes. They are sweet and nice. Sometimes we sit under the tree and drink tea. I love Grandma's garden.

questions.q: Where is Grandma's garden?
questions.explanation: 第一句说 “a small garden behind her house”，选 C，观察真仔细！

questions.q: What does the writer do in the garden on Sundays?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “I give water to the flowers.”，选 A，答得真棒！

questions.q: When do they pick apples?
questions.explanation: 文中说 “In autumn, we pick big apples from the tree.”，选 C，找得很准！

questions.q: What is this passage about?
questions.explanation: 全文都在讲奶奶的花园和花园里的事情，选 D，主旨抓得稳稳的！

questions.q: In “Grandma plants carrots and potatoes”, the word “plants” means ___.
options: puts in the ground to grow
questions.explanation: plants 在这里是“种植”的意思，选 A，你已经是猜词小高手了！

passages.title: A Picnic in the Park
passages.text:
On Saturday, the sun is hot. Tom and his family go to the park. They take a big bag. In the bag, there are sandwiches, apples and orange juice. They sit under a tree. Tom's little sister, May, eats two sandwiches. Dad drinks some juice. Mum takes photos of the family.

After lunch, Tom flies his kite. The kite goes up and up in the blue sky. May plays with her ball. Everyone is very happy. 'What a good day!' says Dad.

questions.q: Where do Tom and his family go?
questions.explanation: 短文开头就告诉我们，Tom 一家周六去了公园，答对啦！

questions.q: What does May eat?
questions.explanation: 文中说 May 'eats two sandwiches'，细节记得很牢，真棒！

questions.q: Who takes photos of the family?
questions.explanation: 是妈妈在拍照哦，'Mum takes photos of the family'，继续加油！

questions.q: What is the story about?
questions.explanation: 全文讲一家人在公园野餐的快乐时光，主旨抓得很准！

questions.q: What does 'under' mean in the story?
questions.explanation: 'under' 表示'在……下面'，他们坐在树下面，你猜对了吗？

passages.title: Leo's New Hobby
passages.text:
Leo is nine years old. He has a new hobby: drawing. Every day after school, Leo sits at his desk and draws. He draws his cat, his house and his family.

On Monday, Leo shows his picture to his teacher. The teacher says, 'Wow! That is great!' She puts the picture on the classroom wall. All the children look at it. Leo is very happy.

Now he wants to draw every day. 'One day, I want to be an artist,' Leo says to his mum. Mum smiles and gives him a new box of coloured pencils.

questions.q: What is Leo's new hobby?
questions.explanation: Leo 的新爱好是画画，文中一开始就告诉我们啦！

questions.q: When does Leo draw?
questions.explanation: 'Every day after school'，Leo 每天放学后画画，找得很准！

questions.q: What does Mum give Leo?
questions.explanation: 妈妈给了 Leo 一盒彩色铅笔，你读得真细心！

questions.q: What is the story about?
questions.explanation: 整篇故事都在讲 Leo 的新爱好，主旨题答得漂亮！

questions.q: What is an 'artist'?
options: A person who drives a bus
questions.explanation: artist 是画画的人——画家。Leo 长大后也想当画家呢！

passages.title: The Train Ride
passages.text:
Amy and her dad go to the city by train. They walk to the station in the morning. Amy buys two tickets with her dad. The train is long and blue. Amy sits next to the window. She sees green trees, small houses and a big river. 'Look, Dad! Cows!' Amy says.

The train goes fast, but Amy is not scared. She likes the train. After one hour, they arrive in the city. Amy's uncle is waiting at the station. 'Hello, Amy!' he says. 'Do you like the train ride?' 'Yes! It is great!' Amy says with a big smile.

questions.q: How do Amy and her dad go to the city?
questions.explanation: 他们坐火车去城里，'by train' 找到了吗？真棒！

questions.q: What colour is the train?
questions.explanation: 文中说火车 'long and blue'，是蓝色的哦，答对啦！

questions.q: Who is waiting at the station?
questions.explanation: 到站后是叔叔在等 Amy，细节题满分！

questions.q: What is the story about?
questions.explanation: 故事主要讲 Amy 的火车之旅，你的理解力很棒！

questions.q: What does 'arrive' mean?
questions.explanation: 'arrive' 表示'到达'，一小时后他们到达了城里，猜对了吗？

passages.title: Mum's Birthday
passages.text:
Today is Mum's birthday, but it is a secret. Jack and his dad want to give her a surprise. In the morning, Mum is at work. Jack and Dad make a big chocolate cake. Dad cooks, and Jack puts yellow flowers on the table. Then Jack makes a birthday card. He draws a red heart on it.

At six o'clock, Mum comes home. 'Surprise!' Jack and Dad shout. Mum looks at the cake, the flowers and the card. Her eyes are wet, but she is smiling. 'I am so happy,' she says. 'This is my best birthday!'

questions.q: Whose birthday is it?
questions.explanation: 今天是妈妈的生日，Jack 和爸爸在准备惊喜，你读得很认真！

questions.q: What does Jack put on the table?
questions.explanation: Jack 把黄色的花放在桌上，细节观察力很强！

questions.q: What does Jack draw on the card?
questions.explanation: 卡片上画了一颗红色的心，答对啦！

questions.q: What is the story about?
questions.explanation: 全文讲给妈妈的生日惊喜，主旨把握得很好！

questions.q: What is a 'surprise'?
questions.explanation: surprise 是'意想不到的事'，妈妈收到惊喜时开心极了！

passages.title: My Busy Saturday
passages.text:
Sam is always busy on Saturdays. He gets up at eight o'clock and makes his bed. After breakfast, he helps his mum clean the house. Sam washes the cups and plates.

At ten o'clock, Sam has a swimming lesson. He can swim very well now. In the afternoon, Sam visits his grandpa. They play chess together. Grandpa always wins, but Sam doesn't mind.

In the evening, Sam does his homework and reads a book. He goes to bed at nine o'clock. 'Saturday is my favourite day,' Sam says. 'I can do lots of fun things!'

questions.q: What time does Sam get up on Saturday?
questions.explanation: Sam 八点起床，'gets up at eight o'clock'，找到啦！

questions.q: What does Sam do after breakfast?
questions.explanation: 早饭后 Sam 帮妈妈打扫房子，你真细心！

questions.q: Who always wins at chess?
questions.explanation: 'Grandpa always wins'，爷爷下棋总是赢，答得漂亮！

questions.q: What does the story tell us about?
questions.explanation: 故事讲 Sam 忙碌的周六一整天，主旨题又答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'favourite' mean?
questions.explanation: 'favourite' 是'最喜欢的'，周六是 Sam 最喜欢的一天！

passages.title: The Big Dinosaur
passages.text:
Tim likes dinosaurs. He has many dinosaur books at home. Today, his class goes to a museum. Tim sees a very big dinosaur there. It is long and tall. 'It is a T-Rex!' says Tim. The T-Rex has big teeth and small arms. Tim's friend Sam is a little scared. 'It is not real,' says Tim. 'It is just bones.' The teacher tells the class about dinosaurs.

Tim draws the T-Rex in his notebook. At home, he shows the picture to Mum. 'Great job!' says Mum. Tim is very happy.

questions.q: Where does Tim's class go today?
questions.explanation: 短文第三句说，Tim 的班级今天去博物馆（museum），答对啦！

questions.q: What does the T-Rex have?
questions.explanation: 文中写到 T-Rex 有大大的牙齿和小小的手臂，你找得真准！

questions.q: What does Tim draw in his notebook?
questions.explanation: 第二段开头说 Tim 在笔记本上画了那只 T-Rex，真棒！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Tim sees dinosaurs at a museum
questions.explanation: 整篇短文讲的是 Tim 班级去博物馆看恐龙的一天，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: What does 'bones' mean in the story?
options: Hard white parts inside the body
questions.explanation: bones 是骨头的意思，博物馆里的恐龙只剩骨头啦，猜对了！

passages.title: Rocket to the Moon
passages.text:
Leo loves space. He has a toy rocket. It is red and white. At night, Leo looks at the stars. 'I want to go to the moon,' he says. Dad reads him a book about rockets. Rockets are very fast. They go up, up, up into the sky. Astronauts sit in the rocket. They wear special suits.

Leo makes a rocket with paper. He counts, 'Three, two, one, go!' The paper rocket flies across the room. Leo laughs and says, 'One day, I will fly a real rocket!'

questions.q: What color is Leo's toy rocket?
questions.explanation: 短文开头说 Leo 的玩具火箭是红白相间的，没错！

questions.q: Who reads Leo a book about rockets?
questions.explanation: 是爸爸给 Leo 读关于火箭的书，细节记得真牢！

questions.q: What does Leo make with paper?
questions.explanation: 第二段说 Leo 用纸做了一个火箭，还倒数发射呢，真有趣！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 整篇都在讲 Leo 对太空和火箭的热爱，主旨答对了！

questions.q: What does 'astronauts' mean?
questions.explanation: astronauts 就是宇航员，坐火箭飞上太空的人，你猜对啦！

passages.title: My Robot Friend
passages.text:
Ben gets a robot for his birthday. The robot is small and blue. Its name is Robo. Robo can walk and talk. 'Hello, Ben!' says Robo. Ben is very happy. Robo can sing songs too. It sings with Ben at breakfast. Robo also helps Ben find his socks. 'Thank you, Robo!' says Ben.

At night, Ben puts Robo on the desk. 'Good night, Robo,' says Ben. Robo's eyes go dark. Ben smiles. He has a new best friend.

questions.q: What color is Robo?
questions.explanation: 短文第二句说机器人 Robo 是蓝色的，答对啦！

questions.q: What does Robo help Ben find?
questions.explanation: Robo 帮 Ben 找到了袜子，真是个好帮手！

questions.q: Where does Ben put Robo at night?
questions.explanation: 晚上 Ben 把 Robo 放在书桌（desk）上，细节全对！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Ben 的新机器人朋友 Robo，主旨抓得准！

questions.q: 'Robo's eyes go dark.' What does 'dark' mean here?
questions.explanation: go dark 是灯光熄灭、变暗的意思，Robo 要睡觉啦，猜得好！

passages.title: The Soccer Cup
passages.text:
It is Saturday morning. Max plays soccer with his team. The game is in the park. Max runs fast with the ball. A boy from the other team runs after him. Max kicks the ball. Goal! His friends jump and shout. In the second half, Max kicks one more goal. His team wins two to one.

After the game, the coach gives Max a small cup. 'You played very well,' says the coach. Max is tired but happy. He loves soccer very much.

questions.q: Where is the soccer game?
questions.explanation: 短文第三句说比赛在公园里进行，没错！

questions.q: How many goals does Max kick?
questions.explanation: Max 先进一球，下半场又进一球，一共两球，数得真清楚！

questions.q: What does the coach give Max?
questions.explanation: 教练给了 Max 一个小奖杯（cup），奖励他踢得好！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Max's team wins a soccer game
questions.explanation: 整篇讲的是 Max 和球队赢得足球比赛的故事，主旨答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'coach' mean?
options: A person who trains a team
A person who drives a bus
questions.explanation: coach 是教练，教球队训练的人，你猜对了！

passages.title: A New Pet
passages.text:
Kim wants a pet. She cannot have a dog because their home is small. Dad has an idea. They go to the pet shop. Kim sees fish, birds and cats. Then she sees a little hamster. It is brown and white. It runs in a wheel. 'I want this one!' says Kim.

The hamster's name is Nuts. Nuts likes to eat seeds. He sleeps in the day and runs at night. Kim cleans his home every week. Nuts is small, but he makes Kim very happy.

questions.q: Why can't Kim have a dog?
questions.explanation: 短文第二句说，因为他们家很小，所以不能养狗，答对啦！

questions.q: What pet does Kim get?
questions.explanation: Kim 最后选了一只棕白相间的小仓鼠，选得真好！

questions.q: When does Nuts run?
questions.explanation: Nuts 白天睡觉，晚上才跑步，仓鼠就是这样哦！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Kim gets a new pet hamster
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Kim 得到新宠物仓鼠 Nuts 的故事，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: What does 'wheel' mean in the story?
questions.explanation: wheel 是会转动的轮子，仓鼠在轮子里跑步，猜对啦！

passages.title: Under the Sea
passages.text:
The sea is full of animals. Fish swim in big groups. They are red, yellow and blue. A turtle swims slowly. It is very old. Crabs walk on the sand. They have big claws. Look! A dolphin jumps out of the water. Dolphins are smart and friendly. They like to play.

But some animals are dangerous. A shark has sharp teeth. Jellyfish can sting. The sea is beautiful, but we must be careful. We should keep the sea clean, so the animals can live well.

questions.q: Which animal swims slowly?
questions.explanation: 文中说乌龟（turtle）游得很慢，而且年纪很大，答对了！

questions.q: What do dolphins like to do?
questions.explanation: 海豚聪明又友好，还喜欢玩耍，你找得真准！

questions.q: What animal has sharp teeth?
questions.explanation: 鲨鱼（shark）有锋利的牙齿，要小心哦！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Sea animals and keeping the sea clean
How to swim in the sea
questions.explanation: 短文介绍了海洋动物，还告诉我们要保持大海干净，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: 'Jellyfish can sting.' What does 'sting' mean?
questions.explanation: sting 是蜇人、用毒刺伤的意思，水母可不能乱碰，猜对啦！

passages.title: Super Ants
passages.text:
Ants are very small, but they are super strong. An ant can carry things much bigger than its body. Look at this ant! It carries a big leaf. Ants live together in a big family. Some ants find food. Some ants look after the babies. They all work very hard.

Ants talk with their feelers. They say, 'Food is this way!' Then many ants come to help. One ant cannot carry a big cake. But one hundred ants can! Teamwork makes ants super.

questions.q: What does the ant carry in the story?
questions.explanation: 文中那只蚂蚁正背着一片大叶子，力气真大，答对啦！

questions.q: How do ants talk to each other?
questions.explanation: 蚂蚁用触角（feelers）互相传递消息，真神奇！

questions.q: How many ants can carry a big cake?
questions.explanation: 一只蚂蚁搬不动大蛋糕，但一百只蚂蚁就可以，团结力量大！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Ants are small but strong and work together
How to find an ant home
questions.explanation: 短文告诉我们蚂蚁虽小却很强壮，还会团队合作，主旨答对了！

questions.q: What does 'teamwork' mean?
questions.explanation: teamwork 是团队合作的意思，大家一起做事就更厉害，猜得好！

passages.title: Captain Star
passages.text:
Captain Star is a superhero. He wears a red cape and blue boots. He can fly very high in the sky. He can run very fast too. Every day, he helps people in the city. Today, a little cat is in a tall tree. It cannot get down. The cat's owner is very sad.

Captain Star flies up, up, up. He takes the cat down safely. 'Thank you, Captain Star!' says the girl. Captain Star smiles. 'Helping people is my job,' he says. Then he flies away.

questions.q: What color is Captain Star's cape?
questions.explanation: Captain Star 披着红色披风、穿着蓝色靴子，答对啦！

questions.q: Where is the little cat?
questions.explanation: 小猫被困在高高的树上下不来了，真让人着急！

questions.q: What does Captain Star do every day?
questions.explanation: Captain Star 每天都在城市里帮助人们，超级英雄就是这样！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A superhero helps a little cat
How to fly in the sky
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是超级英雄 Captain Star 救下小猫的故事，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: What does 'cape' mean?
options: A long cloth worn on the back
questions.explanation: cape 是披风，超级英雄最爱穿啦，猜对啦！

passages.title: The Funniest Day at School
passages.text:
Today is Funny Hat Day at school. Everyone must wear a funny hat. Tom wears a hat with a toy duck on it. His best friend Jack wears a pizza hat. It looks like a real pizza! The teachers wear funny hats too. Miss Lee has a big flower hat with long green leaves.

At lunch, the class has a hat show. Everyone walks and shows their hats. The class laughs and claps. Tom's duck hat wins first prize! The prize is a box of colored pencils. 'This is the best day at school,' says Tom. When he gets home, he puts a photo of his duck hat on the wall. He will remember this funny day for a long time.

questions.q: What is on Tom's hat?
questions.explanation: Tom 的帽子上有一只玩具鸭子，还得了第一名呢！

questions.q: What does Jack's hat look like?
questions.explanation: Jack 的帽子看起来像真的披萨，太有创意了！

questions.q: What is the first prize?
questions.explanation: 第一名的奖品是一盒彩色铅笔，Tom 真厉害！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A funny hat day at school
questions.explanation: 整篇讲的是学校滑稽帽子日的趣事，主旨答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'prize' mean?
options: Something you get when you win
questions.explanation: prize 是奖品，赢了比赛就能得到，猜得真好！

passages.title: Camping with Dad
passages.text:
Last weekend, Sam went camping with his dad. They drove to a lake in the mountains. First, they put up a tent. Sam helped with the poles. Then they made a fire and cooked sausages. The sausages were delicious. At night, they sat by the fire and looked at the stars. Sam saw a shooting star! 'Make a wish,' said Dad. Sam closed his eyes and made a wish.

In the morning, birds sang loudly. Sam and Dad went fishing by the lake. Sam caught one small fish. They let it go back into the lake. It was a great weekend, and Sam wants to go camping again soon.

questions.q: Where did Sam and Dad go camping?
options: Near a lake in the mountains
questions.explanation: 他们开车去了山里的一个湖边露营，答对啦！

questions.q: What did they cook on the fire?
questions.explanation: 他们在火上烤了香肠，美味极了！

questions.q: What did Sam see in the sky at night?
questions.explanation: Sam 看到了一颗流星，还许了愿呢，真幸运！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Sam's camping trip with his dad
A day at the lake school
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Sam 和爸爸愉快的露营周末，主旨抓得准！

questions.q: 'Make a wish.' What does 'wish' mean?
questions.explanation: wish 是愿望，看到流星时许个愿吧，猜对啦！

passages.title: Pizza Day
passages.text:
Every Friday, Milo's family makes pizza at home. It is their favorite day of the week. Mum makes the dough. Milo puts tomato sauce on it. His sister Amy puts on cheese. Dad cuts the peppers and mushrooms. Milo loves cheese, so he always puts on a lot!

Then they put the pizza in the oven. The kitchen smells so good. After twenty minutes, the pizza is ready. It is hot and crispy. The family eats at the table together. Milo eats three big pieces. 'Your pizza is the best,' says Dad. Milo smiles. Making pizza is fun, and eating it is even better.

questions.q: When does Milo's family make pizza?
questions.explanation: 每周五是 Milo 家的披萨日，记住啦，答对啦！

questions.q: Who cuts the peppers and mushrooms?
questions.explanation: 爸爸负责切彩椒和蘑菇，一家人分工合作！

questions.q: How many pieces does Milo eat?
questions.explanation: Milo 吃了三大块披萨，胃口真好！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是一家人每周五一起做披萨的快乐时光，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: 'The pizza is hot and crispy.' What does 'crispy' mean?
questions.explanation: crispy 是酥脆的意思，刚烤好的披萨边脆脆的，猜对啦！

passages.title: The Big Snow
passages.text:
Yesterday, it snowed all night. In the morning, everything outside was white. School was closed! Dan was so happy. He put on his coat, hat and gloves. He ran outside with his sister. They made a big snowman in the garden. It had two black eyes and a long carrot nose.

Then they had a snowball fight with their friends. Dan threw a snowball, and it hit his friend right on the head! Everyone laughed loudly. After that, Mum made hot chocolate for the children. Dan's hands were cold, but the chocolate was warm and sweet. Dan hopes it will snow again very soon.

questions.q: Why was Dan so happy in the morning?
questions.explanation: 下了一夜大雪，学校停课了，所以 Dan 特别开心！

questions.q: What was the snowman's nose?
questions.explanation: 雪人有一个长长的胡萝卜鼻子，真可爱！

questions.q: What did Mum make for the children?
questions.explanation: 妈妈做了热巧克力，又暖和又甜，答对啦！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Dan's fun day in the snow
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Dan 在雪天里玩耍的快乐一天，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: 'Dan threw a snowball.' What does 'threw' mean?
options: Sent through the air by hand
questions.explanation: threw 是 throw（扔、抛）的过去式，Dan 扔出雪球打中了朋友，猜对啦！

passages.title: Jack's Birthday Surprise
passages.text:
Today is Jack's birthday. He is nine years old. When he comes home from school, the house is very quiet. 'Where is everyone?' Jack says. He opens the door slowly. 'Surprise!' Everyone jumps out from behind the sofa. His friends are all here! There are colorful balloons and a big cake on the table.

The cake is blue, Jack's favorite color. It has nine candles on it. Jack blows out the candles and makes a wish. Then they play games and eat cake together. Jack gets many nice presents. The best present is a football from Dad. 'This is the best birthday ever!' says Jack with a big smile.

questions.q: How old is Jack today?
questions.explanation: Jack 今天九岁了，蛋糕上正好有九根蜡烛！

questions.q: What color is the birthday cake?
questions.explanation: 蛋糕是蓝色的，那是 Jack 最喜欢的颜色！

questions.q: What is the best present for Jack?
questions.explanation: 最棒的礼物是爸爸送的足球，Jack 一定特别喜欢！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是大家为 Jack 准备的惊喜生日派对，主旨答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'candles' mean?
options: Small sticks of wax that burn
questions.explanation: candles 是蜡烛，生日蛋糕上点蜡烛许愿是我们的传统，猜得好！

passages.title: A Trip to the Beach
passages.text:
Last summer, Amy went to the beach with her family. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. Every morning, Amy swam in the blue water. The waves were big and fun. Her brother collected shells on the sand. He even found a pink one!

One day, they took a boat trip. They saw dolphins jumping near the boat. Amy took many photos of them. In the evening, the family ate fish and chips by the sea. The sun went down slowly, and the sky turned orange and pink. It was beautiful. Amy loved the beach very much. She wants to go back there next summer.

questions.q: Where did Amy's family stay?
options: In a small hotel near the sea
questions.explanation: 他们住在海边的一家小旅馆，离大海很近！

questions.q: What did Amy's brother collect?
questions.explanation: 弟弟在沙滩上捡贝壳，还找到了一个粉色的，真幸运！

questions.q: What animals did they see on the boat trip?
questions.explanation: 坐船时他们看到海豚在船边跳跃，Amy 拍了好多照片！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Amy's family trip to the beach
How to swim in the sea
A boat trip to an island
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Amy 一家人美好的海边之旅，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: 'The waves were big and fun.' What does 'waves' mean?
questions.explanation: waves 是海浪，一波一波的海水冲上岸，猜对啦！

passages.title: Game Night
passages.text:
Friday is game night at Chen's home. After dinner, the family plays games together in the living room. Chen likes board games best. Tonight, they play a racing game. Dad's car is red, and Chen's car is green. Chen rolls the dice. Six! His little green car goes very fast on the board.

Mum plays a card game with Chen's little sister, because she is too small for the racing game. Later, Chen wins the race! 'Good game!' says Dad with a smile. Then they all laugh and eat cookies together. Game night is not just about winning. It is about having fun with the family. Chen hopes every night could be game night.

questions.q: When is game night at Chen's home?
questions.explanation: 每周五晚上是 Chen 家的游戏之夜，答对啦！

questions.q: What color is Chen's car in the racing game?
questions.explanation: 爸爸的车是红色的，Chen 的车是绿色的，别记混哦！

questions.q: Who wins the race?
questions.explanation: Chen 掷出六点，小车跑得飞快，最后赢了比赛！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Chen 一家快乐的家庭游戏之夜，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: What does 'dice' mean?
options: A small cube with dots or numbers
questions.explanation: dice 是骰子，掷出六点就能走六步，猜对啦！

passages.title: The Mountain That Smokes
passages.text:
Jack read a book about volcanoes. A volcano is a mountain that can open and throw out hot rocks. Deep under the ground, the rock is very hot and soft. It is called magma. When magma comes out, it is called lava.

Some volcanoes sleep for many years. But one day they can wake up. Smoke and ash go high into the sky. Lava runs down the mountain like a slow red river.

People who live near a volcano must be careful. Scientists watch the volcano every day, so they can tell people when it is not safe. Jack thinks their job is very cool. He wants to see a volcano one day, but only from far away!

questions.q: What is magma?
options: Hot, soft rock under the ground
questions.explanation: 答对啦！文中第一段说地下的岩石又热又软，叫做 magma，所以选 A。

questions.q: What is lava?
questions.explanation: 真棒！第一段最后一句告诉我们，magma 流出来以后就叫 lava。

questions.q: What do scientists do every day?
questions.explanation: 没错！第三段说科学家每天观察火山，这样才能提醒大家注意安全。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Volcanoes and the people who watch them
questions.explanation: 很好！全文讲了火山是什么，以及科学家如何守护大家的安全，C 概括得最全面。

questions.q: What does "ash" mean in the story?
options: Very small grey pieces after something burns
questions.explanation: 猜对了！ash 是火山喷出的细小灰粒，火山爆发时会和烟一起冲上天空。

passages.title: Life on the Space Station
passages.text:
Tim watched a video about the space station. It is like a big house in space. Astronauts live and work there for many months.

There is no gravity in space, so things float! Astronauts sleep in bags on the wall because they do not want to float away. They eat food from bags and drink water through a straw.

Every day, the astronauts exercise for two hours. This keeps their bodies strong. They also do science tests and fix the station.

From the window, they can see the Earth. It looks like a blue and white ball. Tim thinks it must be the best view in the world. "I want to go there too," he says. But first, he must study hard and eat his vegetables!

questions.q: Why do astronauts sleep in bags on the wall?
options: So they do not float away
So they can see the Earth
questions.explanation: 答对啦！太空没有重力，宇航员睡在墙上的睡袋里才不会飘走。

questions.q: How long do astronauts exercise every day?
questions.explanation: 真棒！第三段第一句写得很清楚：每天锻炼两小时，让身体保持强壮。

questions.q: What does the Earth look like from the window?
questions.explanation: 没错！从空间站窗口看，地球像一个蓝白相间的球。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: 很好！整篇文章介绍了宇航员在空间站里睡觉、吃饭、锻炼和工作的日常生活。

questions.q: What does "float" mean in the story?
options: To stay in the air without falling
questions.explanation: 猜对了！float 是“漂浮”的意思，太空里东西会飘在空中，真神奇！

passages.title: Sam Makes a Game
passages.text:
Sam is nine years old. He loves computers. Last month, his teacher showed the class how to code. Coding means telling the computer what to do.

At first, it was hard. Sam typed and typed, but the little cat on the screen did not move. He felt sad, but he did not stop. He read his code again and found a small mistake. He fixed it, and the cat jumped!

Now Sam is making his own game. In the game, a dog runs after a ball. If the dog gets the ball, you win ten points. His friends all want to play it.

"Coding is like magic," Sam says. "But the magic words are words that I write!"

questions.q: Who showed Sam how to code?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段说上个月老师教全班同学编程。

questions.q: What happened after Sam fixed the small mistake?
questions.explanation: 真棒！他改掉小错误之后，屏幕上的小猫跳起来了。

questions.q: How many points do you win in Sam's game?
questions.explanation: 没错！小狗追到球就能得十分，他的朋友们都想玩这个游戏。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A boy who learns to code and makes a game
questions.explanation: 很好！全文讲 Sam 学习编程、克服困难，最后做出自己的小游戏。

questions.q: In this story, what does "coding" mean?
options: Telling the computer what to do
questions.explanation: 猜对了！文中第一段就解释了：编程就是告诉电脑该做什么。

passages.title: The Last Shot
passages.text:
The school basketball game was almost over. Ben's team was losing by one point. There were only ten seconds left.

Ben's friend Tom ran fast and passed the ball to him. Ben was near the line, but two tall boys stood in front of him. He could not run to the basket.

So Ben jumped and threw the ball. It flew high in the air. Everyone was quiet. The ball hit the board and dropped into the basket!

"Three points!" shouted the coach. Ben's team won the game. The boys jumped and laughed together.

After the game, the other team's captain came over. "Great shot," he said, and shook Ben's hand. Ben smiled. Winning was fun, but playing fair and making friends felt even better.

questions.q: How many seconds were left in the game?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段最后说比赛只剩十秒钟，真紧张！

questions.q: Why couldn't Ben run to the basket?
options: Two tall boys stood in front of him
questions.explanation: 没错！两个高个子男孩挡在前面，所以他只能原地投篮。

questions.q: What did the other team's captain do after the game?
questions.explanation: 真棒！对方队长走过来和 Ben 握手，还夸他投得好。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Ben wins a game with a great shot and plays fair
questions.explanation: 很好！故事讲 Ben 最后一投反败为胜，还展现了友谊和公平竞赛精神。

questions.q: What does "passed the ball" mean?
options: Threw or gave the ball to a teammate
questions.explanation: 猜对了！pass 就是传球，Tom 快速把球传给了 Ben。

passages.title: Saving the Sea Turtles
passages.text:
Amy and her dad walked on the beach early in the morning. Suddenly, Amy saw something move in the sand. It was a baby sea turtle!

"The turtles come out of their eggs at night," Dad said. "Then they walk to the sea. But this one is late."

Amy wanted to pick it up, but Dad said no. "It must walk by itself. This makes its legs strong." So they watched the little turtle walk slowly over the sand. At last, a small wave took it into the sea.

Many sea turtles are in danger because people leave plastic bags on the beach. Turtles think the bags are food. Amy and her dad picked up all the plastic they could find. "We helped more than one turtle today," Dad said with a smile.

questions.q: When do baby turtles come out of their eggs?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！爸爸说小海龟晚上破壳，然后爬向大海。

questions.q: Why couldn't Amy pick up the turtle?
questions.explanation: 没错！小海龟必须自己爬，这样腿才能变得强壮。

questions.q: Why are plastic bags dangerous for turtles?
options: Turtles think the bags are food
Turtles like to play with them
questions.explanation: 真棒！海龟会把塑料袋当成食物，所以很危险，我们要带走垃圾。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How Amy and her dad helped sea turtles
questions.explanation: 很好！Amy 和爸爸既守护了小海龟入海，又捡走了塑料垃圾。

questions.q: What does "in danger" mean?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！in danger 表示“处于危险中”，所以我们要保护海龟。

passages.title: The Map in the Attic
passages.text:
On a rainy Saturday, Leo went up to the attic with his grandpa. In an old box, he found a yellow map. It had a big red X on it!

"That is your old treasure map," Grandpa laughed. "You made it when you were five."

"I don't remember," said Leo. "Let's follow it!" The map showed the garden. Leo took a small shovel, and they walked to the apple tree. Ten steps left, the map said. Leo started to dig.

Soon, the shovel hit something hard. It was an old cookie tin! Inside, there were three marbles, a toy car, and a photo of little Leo with his grandpa.

"This is a real treasure," Grandpa said softly. Leo smiled. He put new things in the tin and hid it again, for the next pirate to find.

questions.q: Where did Leo find the map?
options: In an old box in the attic
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段说 Leo 和爷爷在阁楼的旧箱子里发现了地图。

questions.q: Who made the map?
questions.explanation: 真棒！爷爷笑着说，这是 Leo 五岁时自己画的藏宝图。

questions.q: What was inside the cookie tin?
options: Marbles, a toy car, and a photo
questions.explanation: 没错！铁盒里有三颗弹珠、一辆玩具车和一张小 Leo 与爷爷的合影。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A pirate who lost his gold
Leo follows his old treasure map with Grandpa
questions.explanation: 很好！Leo 和爷爷按童年的藏宝图寻宝，找到了最珍贵的回忆。

questions.q: Grandpa said it "softly". What does that mean?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！softly 是“轻声地”，爷爷的话里满是温柔的爱。

passages.title: The Boy Who Fixed Things
passages.text:
Marcus loves machines. When his toy breaks, he does not cry. He opens it and looks inside.

His hero is a young inventor he saw on TV. The girl on TV made a small machine that cleans water. "Anyone can be an inventor," she said. "You just need to see a problem and try to fix it."

Last week, Marcus saw a problem at home. His little brother could not reach the light switch. So Marcus found a short stick and some string. He tied the string to the switch. Now his brother can pull the string and turn the light on!

Mum called it a great invention. Marcus felt proud. He has a notebook now. On the first page, he wrote: "Ideas that can help people." He writes one idea in it every night before bed.

questions.q: What does Marcus do when a toy breaks?
options: He opens it and looks inside
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段说玩具坏了他不哭，而是拆开看看里面。

questions.q: What did the girl on TV invent?
questions.explanation: 真棒！电视里的女孩发明了一台能净化水的小机器。

questions.q: How does Marcus's brother turn on the light now?
questions.explanation: 没错！Marcus 把绳子系在开关上，弟弟一拉绳灯就亮了。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Marcus fixes problems like a young inventor
questions.explanation: 很好！Marcus 受小发明家鼓舞，动手解决生活中的问题。

questions.q: Marcus felt "proud". What does that mean?
options: Happy about something he did well
questions.explanation: 猜对了！proud 是“自豪的”，帮助别人会让人心里特别自豪。

passages.title: Our First Night in a Tent
passages.text:
Dan and his family went camping by a lake. Dad showed Dan how to put up the tent. It was not easy, but they worked together, and soon the tent stood tall.

At night, Mum cooked soup on a small fire. The soup tasted better than any soup at home. "Food is always good outside," Dad said.

After dinner, they looked at the stars. There were thousands of them! In the city, Dan could only see a few stars because of the lights. Here, the sky was full.

When it was time to sleep, Dan heard a strange sound. "What is that?" he whispered. "Just a frog," Mum said. Dan laughed. He felt a little scared, but also very happy.

The next morning, Dan woke up to the sound of birds. "Can we camp here again next year?" he asked. Everyone said yes.

questions.q: Where did Dan's family go camping?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一句就说他们全家去湖边露营。

questions.q: Why could Dan only see a few stars in the city?
questions.explanation: 没错！城市灯光太亮，所以只能看到几颗星星；湖边却有成千上万颗。

questions.q: What made the strange sound at night?
questions.explanation: 真棒！妈妈说那只是一只青蛙，Dan 听完就笑了。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to put up a tent
Dan's happy first night of camping
questions.explanation: 很好！全文记录了 Dan 第一次露营过夜的新鲜与快乐。

questions.q: What does "whispered" mean?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！whisper 是“小声说”，夜里怕吵到别人就会这样说话。

passages.title: The Night of the Storm
passages.text:
The sky turned black in the middle of the afternoon. Mia was doing her homework when the first drop of rain hit the window. Then the wind began to howl like a hungry wolf.

"Close all the windows!" called Mum. Mia ran from room to room. Outside, the trees were dancing wildly. A branch broke off the big tree and fell onto the road with a crash.

Suddenly, all the lights went out. The house was dark. Mia felt scared, but Dad lit some candles, and the family sat together in the living room. They played a word game and told funny stories while the storm shouted outside.

Later, the rain stopped. The wind grew tired and went to sleep. Mia looked out of the window and saw a hundred stars in a clean, dark sky.

The next morning, the street was a mess of leaves and branches. Neighbors came out with brooms, and everyone worked together. By lunchtime, the road was clean again.

"Storms can break things," Dad said, "but they also bring people together." Mia thought about this as she helped sweep the last leaves into a bag.

questions.q: What was Mia doing when the rain started?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段说第一滴雨打在窗户上时，Mia 正在写作业。

questions.q: What did the family do when the lights went out?
options: They played a word game and told stories
questions.explanation: 真棒！停电后爸爸点上蜡烛，全家人一起玩文字游戏、讲有趣的故事。

questions.q: Who cleaned the street the next morning?
questions.explanation: 没错！邻居们都拿着扫帚出来，大家一起干活，午饭前马路就干净了。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A storm brings trouble but also brings people together
questions.explanation: 很好！暴风雨虽然带来麻烦，却让一家人更亲密、让邻居们更团结。

questions.q: The wind began to "howl". What does that mean?
options: To make a long, loud sound
questions.explanation: 猜对了！howl 形容风发出又长又响的呼啸声，像狼嚎一样。

passages.title: One Hello Away
passages.text:
When Omar first came to our school, he did not talk to anyone. He sat alone at lunch and looked at his food. Some kids thought he was unfriendly, but I thought he was just shy.

One day, I saw him drawing a robot in his notebook. It was the best robot I had ever seen. "That's amazing!" I said before I could stop myself. Omar looked up, surprised. Then he smiled for the first time.

"You like robots?" he asked quietly. "Love them," I said, and I sat down next to him.

That was the start of everything. We found out that we both liked the same books and the same games. Omar taught me how to draw robots, and I taught him how to play football. He wasn't very good at first, but he laughed so much that we both fell over on the grass.

Now Omar is not quiet any more. He talks and jokes all day long. Last week, he told me, "I was scared to come to this school. But then you spoke to me, and everything was okay."

I learned something important: a new friend might be just one hello away. All you have to do is say it.

questions.q: What was Omar drawing in his notebook?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第二段说 Omar 在笔记本上画了一个最棒的机器人。

questions.q: What did the writer teach Omar?
questions.explanation: 真棒！Omar 教“我”画机器人，“我”教 Omar 踢足球。

questions.q: How did Omar feel about the new school at first?
questions.explanation: 没错！最后 Omar 说，他刚来学校时心里很害怕。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How one hello started a friendship
questions.explanation: 很好！一句主动的问候开启了两个人的友谊，这就是全文的主题。

questions.q: What does "shy" mean in the story?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！shy 是“害羞的”，Omar 不是不友好，只是有点害羞。

passages.title: Sports Day Surprise
passages.text:
Our school has a Sports Day every June. Last year, I won nothing, so this year I trained hard. Every morning before school, I ran around the park.

On the big day, the sun was hot and the field was full of parents. My first race was the hundred meters. When the teacher shouted "Go!", I ran faster than I had ever run. I came second! It was not first place, but it was my first medal ever — silver and beautiful.

Then came the three-legged race. My partner was my best friend Ali. We tied our legs together and practiced all week. "Left, right, left, right!" we shouted as we ran. Halfway to the finish line, the team next to us fell down like a bag of potatoes. We almost fell too, but Ali grabbed my arm and we stayed up. We won!

The funniest race was the egg-and-spoon race. You carry an egg on a spoon without dropping it. My egg fell three times, but it never broke. The crowd laughed and cheered.

At the end, our class won the big cup. We all lifted it together, and the head teacher took our photo. It hangs in the school hall now, and every time I walk past it, I remember that training hard really works.

questions.q: How did the writer train for Sports Day?
options: He ran around the park every morning
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段说他每天上学前绕着公园跑步训练。

questions.q: What did the writer win in the hundred meters?
options: Second place and a silver medal
questions.explanation: 真棒！他跑出第二名，得到了人生中第一枚奖牌——银牌。

questions.q: How many times did the egg fall in the egg-and-spoon race?
questions.explanation: 没错！鸡蛋掉了三次，居然一次都没破，观众都笑了。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Training hard helps the writer do well on Sports Day
questions.explanation: 很好！通过刻苦训练，作者在运动会收获奖牌和奖杯，证明了努力有用。

questions.q: What does "grabbed" mean in the story?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！grab 是“一把抓住”，Ali 抓住他的胳膊，两人才没摔倒。

passages.title: The Egg That Wouldn't Sink
passages.text:
Our science teacher, Mr. Chen, likes to surprise us. Last Friday, he walked into class with two glasses of water, two eggs, and a big box of salt.

"Can an egg float?" he asked. We all shouted "No!"

He dropped an egg into the first glass. It sank to the bottom, just as we thought. Then he poured five spoons of salt into the second glass and stirred until the water turned cloudy. He dropped in the second egg, and something amazing happened: the egg floated!

"How?!" we shouted together.

Mr. Chen smiled. "Salt water is heavier than plain water. Heavy water can hold up more things. That is why it is easier to float in the sea than in a swimming pool."

He let us try it ourselves in small groups. My group added too little salt at first, and our egg just hung in the middle of the glass like a tiny moon. We laughed and added more salt until it popped to the top.

At the end of the lesson, Mr. Chen said, "Science is not about knowing answers. It is about asking questions and testing them." I wrote that sentence in my notebook, because I want to be a scientist one day.

questions.q: What did Mr. Chen bring to class?
options: Two glasses of water, two eggs, and salt
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第一段说陈老师带了两杯水、两个鸡蛋和一大盒盐。

questions.q: What happened to the egg in the first glass?
questions.explanation: 没错！第一杯是清水，鸡蛋像大家想的那样沉到了杯底。

questions.q: Why is it easier to float in the sea than in a swimming pool?
questions.explanation: 真棒！盐水比普通水重，能托起更多东西，海水里就更容易浮起来。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A fun science lesson about floating
questions.explanation: 很好！这节科学课用鸡蛋实验告诉大家浮力的道理，还点燃了科学梦。

questions.q: What does "stirred" mean in the story?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！stir 是“搅拌”，陈老师把盐搅进水里直到水变浑浊。

passages.title: How the City Moves
passages.text:
My uncle works for the city. His job is to help people move around. Last week, he took me to see the control room for the underground trains.

The room was full of big screens. Every train in the city was a small green dot on the screens. "At eight o'clock in the morning, more than a million people are moving," my uncle said. "Our job is to keep them safe and on time."

He explained that different people need different ways to travel. Old people and families with babies like buses, because buses stop near their homes. Students often ride bikes. People who work far away take the underground because it is fast and never gets stuck in traffic.

"The best city is one where you don't need a car at all," he said. "Fewer cars mean cleaner air and quieter streets."

On the way home, we took a bus, a train, and then we walked. I looked at all the people around me. Some were reading, some were sleeping, and one man was doing a crossword. I never noticed before how many stories ride the train every morning.

When I grow up, I might do my uncle's job. I would like to design a train that runs on sunshine. He says it might be possible one day.

questions.q: What were the trains on the screens in the control room?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第二段说大屏幕上的每列火车都是一个小小的绿点。

questions.q: Why do old people and families with babies like buses?
questions.explanation: 没错！公交车站离家近，所以老人和有宝宝的家庭喜欢坐公交。

questions.q: What kind of train does the writer want to design?
options: A train that runs on sunshine
questions.explanation: 真棒！结尾说他想设计一列靠阳光奔跑的火车，多有想象力！

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How a city keeps people moving
questions.explanation: 很好！文章介绍了城市里不同交通工具如何让人们安全、准时地出行。

questions.q: The underground never gets "stuck" in traffic. What does "stuck" mean?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！stuck 是“卡住”，地铁不会被堵在路上，所以非常快。

passages.title: The Night of a Thousand Lanterns
passages.text:
On the fifteenth day of the new year, my city celebrates the Lantern Festival. The whole city turns into a sea of lights — my favourite night of the year.

In the morning, my family makes sweet rice balls together. My job is to roll them into small white moons. Grandma says the round shape means the family stays together. When we boil them, they float to the top of the pot, and that means they are ready to eat.

In the evening, we go to the park. Thousands of lanterns hang from the trees. Some look like fish, some like dragons, and one huge one looks like a rocket. Every lantern has a riddle written on it. If you guess the riddle, you win a small prize. I guessed three riddles this year and won a little paper tiger.

The best part is the dragon dance. Twenty men hold up a long golden dragon, and it dances through the crowd to the sound of drums. The dragon's eyes light up, and little children scream with joy.

When we walk home, the sky is full of fireworks. I hold my grandma's hand and make a quiet wish. I can't tell you what it is, because then it won't come true. But it is about next year's festival.

questions.q: What does the family make in the morning?
questions.explanation: 答对啦！早上全家一起做甜甜的汤圆，作者负责把它们搓成白色小圆球。

questions.q: What is written on every lantern?
questions.explanation: 没错！每盏灯笼上都写着一个谜语，猜中了还能赢得小奖品。

questions.q: What prize did the writer win this year?
questions.explanation: 真棒！他今年猜中了三个谜语，赢得了一只小纸老虎。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: The history of the new year
questions.explanation: 很好！文章记录了做汤圆、赏花灯、看舞龙的一整天节日快乐时光。

questions.q: What does "huge" mean in the story?
questions.explanation: 猜对了！huge 是“巨大的”，那盏火箭灯笼一定特别壮观。

passages.title: A Doctor for Animals
passages.text:
Ask my classmates what they want to be, and you will hear many answers. Tom wants to be a football star. Lily wants to be a doctor. I want to be an animal doctor — a vet.

The idea started two years ago, when our cat Momo got sick. She would not eat, and she slept all day. We took her to a small animal hospital near our home. The vet there was a kind woman with calm hands. She listened to Momo's heart, gave her some medicine, and told us not to worry. Three days later, Momo was jumping on the sofa again.

That night, I told my mum, "I want to do that job." She said, "Then you must work hard at science, and you must be patient, because animals cannot tell you where it hurts."

So now I practice. I read books about animals and watch videos about how vets work. Last month, I even helped my neighbor feed her rabbit during her holiday.

I know the road is long and I will need many years of school. But when I imagine my future, I see a small clinic with my name on the door, and a line of happy dogs, cats, and even a parrot. They cannot say thank you, but I will understand them anyway.

questions.q: What was wrong with Momo the cat?
options: She would not eat and slept all day
She was afraid of the vet
questions.explanation: 答对啦！第二段说 Momo 不肯吃东西，整天睡觉，可把大家急坏了。

questions.q: What did Mum say the writer must be, besides good at science?
questions.explanation: 没错！妈妈说还要有耐心，因为动物说不出自己哪里疼。

questions.q: How did the writer practice last month?
options: He helped feed a neighbor's rabbit
questions.explanation: 真棒！邻居度假时，他帮忙喂养了她家的兔子，积累照顾动物的经验。

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Why the writer wants to be a vet
questions.explanation: 很好！Momo 康复的经历让作者立志当兽医，并一直在为梦想努力。

questions.q: What is a "clinic"?
options: A small hospital or doctor's place
questions.explanation: 猜对了！clinic 是“小诊所”，作者梦想未来开一家自己的动物诊所。

passages.title: The School Trip
passages.text:
On Friday, Class 3 goes on a school trip. They go to a farm. The children are very excited.

At the farm, they see many animals. There are cows, sheep, and horses. A farmer shows the children a baby goat. The goat is only two days old. It is white and very small.

The children help the farmer. They give water to the horses. They pick apples from the trees. The apples are red and sweet.

At four o'clock, the children go back to school. They are tired but happy. "The farm is great!" says Ben. "I want to come back again."

questions.q: Where does Class 3 go on Friday?
questions.explanation: 第一段说 They go to a farm。答案就在开头，很好找！

questions.q: How old is the baby goat?
questions.explanation: 第二段说 The goat is only two days old。注意是 days（天），不是 weeks 或 years，你分清了吗？

questions.q: What do the children pick from the trees?
questions.explanation: 第三段说 They pick apples from the trees。答得漂亮！

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A school trip to a farm
questions.explanation: 文章从出发写到回校，讲的是三班的一次农场郊游。A、C、D 都只是其中一部分，选 B 才完整。你会抓主旨了！

questions.q: The word "excited" in the passage means ______.
questions.explanation: 孩子们要去郊游，当然是 excited——又开心又期待！从故事结尾 They are tired but happy 也能帮你确认这个好词。
